I’ve been playing with prompts to generate realistic UGC avatars…

The biggest improvement came from changing the workflow:

Don’t generate the video first.

Generate and lock the avatar first.

I created a small identity kit with:

• A main portrait
• Side-profile reference
• Close-ups of the eyes and upper face
• A feature grid for the hair, skin, nose, mouth and beard
Then I used those images to control the creator’s identity while the app screenshots controlled only what appeared on the phone.
This gives the video model fewer decisions
